# Command reference

Every `kb-arena` command and its options.

## `kb-arena audit`

Find gaps in your documentation.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to audit |
| `--max-sections` | Max sections to audit |
| `--output` | Output JSON path |

## `kb-arena benchmark`

Stage 4: Run benchmark questions against specified strategies.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus name, or 'all' to run all discovered corpora |
| `--dry-run` | Preview what would be benchmarked |
| `--fail-below` | Exit code 1 if accuracy below threshold (0.0-1.0) |
| `--parallel/--no-parallel` | Run strategies in parallel |
| `--ragas` | Enable RAGAS metrics (faithfulness, precision, recall, relevancy) |
| `--reference-free` | Evaluate on faithfulness + relevancy only (no ground truth) |
| `--resume` | Run id to resume. Questions already checkpointed under results/run_<id> are skipped |
| `--runs` | Repeat the whole benchmark N times, one run id each, for spread. The cost cap applies to each run, so N runs can spend N times the cap, which is why this stops at 20. Read the spread with `kb-arena variance`. |
| `--seed` | Seed recorded in every run manifest. Default -1 keeps KB_ARENA_RUN_SEED. It does not control provider-side model sampling. |
| `--split` | Question split: development, validation, holdout, or all |
| `--strategy` | Strategy name or 'all'. Options: naive_vector, contextual_vector, qna_pairs, knowledge_graph, hybrid, raptor, pageindex, bm25, metadata_filtered, temporal, rerank_vector, qiss, sqr. Not in 'all': rerank_vector, sqr |
| `--strategy-module` | Import path for a custom Strategy plugin (e.g. my_pkg.my_strat) |
| `--tier` | Tier filter (0 = all tiers) |
| `--top-k` | Top-k chunks per query (drives IR metrics) |

## `kb-arena build-graph`

Stage 2: Extract entities/relationships, build Neo4j graph.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to build graph for |
| `--schema` | Schema: auto |

## `kb-arena build-vectors`

Stage 3: Build indexes for vector strategies and PageIndex tree.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to build vectors for |
| `--strategy` | Strategy: all, naive_vector, contextual_vector, qna_pairs, raptor, pageindex |

## `kb-arena compare`

Pair two strategies question by question: deltas, CI, effect size, win/tie/loss.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--a` | Strategy A, the baseline |
| `--b` | Strategy B, the candidate |
| `--corpus` | Corpus both results belong to |
| `--lab` | A retriever-lab JSON. Compare two strategies inside it |
| `--metric` | Score field, or latency_ms, or cost_usd |
| `--out` | Where to write the JSON artifact |
| `--run-a` | Run id for A. Default: the latest result file |
| `--run-b` | Run id for B. Default: the latest result file |

## `kb-arena datasets`

List the dataset adapters, or fetch one into a corpus.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--destination` | Where the corpus goes. Required for a download-only set |
| `--name` | Adapter to fetch, or empty to list them |

## `kb-arena demo`

Launch the demo with pre-computed aws-compute benchmark results.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--host` | Host to bind to. The default serves this machine only. Pass 0.0.0.0 to serve the network, and set KB_ARENA_API_TOKEN or KB_ARENA_DEMO_MODE before you do, because the read routes carry your corpus. |
| `--port` | Port to listen on |

## `kb-arena eval`

Evaluate latest benchmark results against thresholds.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ci` | CI mode: exit non-zero on regression |
| `--corpus` | Corpus to evaluate |
| `--format` | Output format: rich, json |
| `--threshold` | Metric thresholds as metric=value (e.g. accuracy=0.7 faithfulness=0.8) |

## `kb-arena evidence`

Write, or check, the record that travels with a committed run.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--check` | Check an existing evidence.json instead |
| `--corpus` | Corpus the run scored |
| `--run-id` | Run to bundle, from results/run_<id> |

## `kb-arena fix`

Generate fix recommendations for weak documentation.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to fix |
| `--max-fixes` | Max fix recommendations |
| `--output` | Output markdown path |

## `kb-arena generate-qa`

Generate Q&A pairs from your documentation.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to generate Q&A pairs for |
| `--output` | Output JSONL path |

## `kb-arena generate-questions`

Auto-generate benchmark questions from ingested documents using LLM.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to generate questions for |
| `--count` | Total questions to generate (distributed across tiers) |

## `kb-arena health`

Report pipeline progress, service connectivity, and API key status by corpus.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--format` | Output format: rich, json |

## `kb-arena holdout-uses`

List every run that opened the sealed holdout split, oldest first.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Only this corpus. Default: every corpus |

## `kb-arena ingest`

Stage 1: Parse raw documents into unified Document model.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus name (e.g. aws-compute, my-docs) |
| `--dry-run` | Preview what would be ingested |
| `--format` | Parser: auto, markdown, html, sec-edgar, pdf, docx, plaintext, web, csv, github |

## `kb-arena init-corpus`

Scaffold a new corpus directory structure.

## `kb-arena label-chunks`

Generate datasets/{corpus}/questions/expected_chunks.yaml with a graded judge.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--allow-bm25-only` | Write labels even when only BM25 answered. The gold set then carries BM25's bias and every strategy is scored against it. |
| `--corpus` | Corpus to label |
| `--force` | Re-label even if labels exist |
| `--n-candidates` | Candidates per question, per retriever in the pool. Every candidate goes in the judge prompt, so this drives the cost of each call. |

## `kb-arena migrate-graph-schema`

Replace pre-0.10 graph constraints after explicit operator confirmation.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--confirm-dedicated-database` | Confirm that the target Neo4j database is dedicated to KB Arena. |
| `--database` | Exact Neo4j database to migrate; also set KB_ARENA_NEO4J_DATABASE to this value. |

## `kb-arena optimize`

Automated retrieval-strategy hyperparameter search.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--chunk-sizes` | Comma-separated chunk-token sizes (chunking strategies only) |
| `--confirm-holdout` | Open the sealed holdout split for one confirmation run. The run is written to results/holdout_uses.jsonl |
| `--corpus` | Corpus to optimize against |
| `--dry-run` | Print the trial plan and cost preview, then exit |
| `--embedding-providers` | Comma-separated embedding providers (openai,voyage,cohere,bge,ollama,gemini) |
| `--max-trials` | Cap trials per strategy (0 = no cap) |
| `--method` | Search method: grid|random |
| `--metric` | Metric to optimize: ndcg|recall|mrr|hit|precision |
| `--reranker-backends` | Comma-separated reranker backends (rerank_vector only) |
| `--seed` | Seed for --method random AND for the bootstrap. Default -1 keeps KB_ARENA_RUN_SEED. One value drives both, so the recorded seed and the so the manifest and the trial order cannot disagree. |
| `--split` | Question split: auto (development when labeled), development, validation, holdout, or all |
| `--strategies` | Strategy filter: 'all' or comma-separated names |
| `--top-ks` | Comma-separated top-k values to sweep |

## `kb-arena quantum-diagnostics`

Honest caveats for the quantum strategies: PCA variance loss per qubit count,

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to profile |
| `--sample-questions` | Questions to time SQR on |

## `kb-arena report`

Generate benchmark report from results JSON.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to generate report for |
| `--format` | Output format: rich, json, csv, html, markdown |
| `--output` | Output file path |
| `--profile` | Decision profile for the ranking: accuracy-first, balanced, latency-bound, cost-bound |

## `kb-arena retriever-lab`

Run retrieval-only benchmark with classical IR metrics. ~10x cheaper than `benchmark`.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ceiling-k` | Deeper cutoff for the retrieval-ceiling diagnostic (0 = top_k*4). Reports base-retriever Recall@top_k vs Recall@ceiling_k = ranking headroom. The diagnostic runs on its own only when a strategy ranks over the naive_vector pool; pass this flag to force it for any run. |
| `--corpus` | Corpus to evaluate |
| `--min-recall` | Exit non-zero if any strategy's mean Recall@k drops below this |
| `--split` | Question split: development, validation, holdout, or all |
| `--strategies` | Strategy filter (or 'all') |
| `--top-k` | Top-k chunks per query |

## `kb-arena run`

One-shot pipeline: ingest -> build-graph -> build-vectors -> generate-questions -> benchmark.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to run end-to-end |
| `--docs` | Optional path/URL/github: spec to ingest before building. If omitted, files in datasets/{corpus}/raw/ are ingested automatically. |
| `--questions` | Auto-generate this many questions if none exist |
| `--resume/--no-resume` | Skip stages whose outputs already exist |
| `--skip-graph` | Skip build-graph (useful when Neo4j is unavailable) |

## `kb-arena serve`

Stage 5: Launch side-by-side chatbot demo.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--host` | Host to bind to |
| `--port` | Port to listen on |
| `--reload` | Enable auto-reload for development |

## `kb-arena variance`

Stage 4b: the spread across repeats of one experiment.

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--corpus` | Corpus to read, or every corpus when empty |
| `--metric` | Result field to spread, averaged over its tiers |
